t: Magnusson 40, 80, 120, and 180 grit multi-material hand sanding sheets offer versatile use for decorators, carpenters, and dryliners preparing wood, paint, metal, and plaster. The versatile 280mm by 230mm sheets are designed for surface preparation and high-quality finishing. A heavy-duty C-weight paper backing provides high flexibility and resists tearing on contoured surfaces. The sharp brown corundum grain ensures efficient material removal with professional results. The 4-pack of assorted 40, 80, 120, and 180 grit sheets covers coarse to fine sanding requirements. Designed strictly for dry use, the sheets actively reduce heat build-up and clogging.
b: Suitable for Sanding Wood, Paint, Metal & Plaster
Adapts to Contoured Surfaces with Flexible Backing
Reduces Clogging for Faster & Smoother Finishes
Paper Backing Resists Tearing for Longer Life
Grit Variety Offers Coarse & Fine Sanding
